source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Note the test record #1 that marked the system/installation, including the serial number on the electronic equipment.
3. Note the date & time of each test record. This can be found in the first electronic test record above and is represented by 313,128,126,246 in the image below
This represents the day of the week of the month and the time in 24hr format
313 represents Monday, Thursday, Saturday, or Sunday
3 = Th -> Thursday
12 = 12:00 PM
8 = 08:00 hours

There are 2 other electronic test records test record number 399,12, and 399,13
The 12 represents the 12:00 PM time
